The *Adhikaraṇasamatha* section of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* (Bu-Vb As1–7), translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali as *The settling of legal issues*, comprises the canonical exposition and analysis of the seven procedural rules for settling disputes and legal questions (*adhikaraṇa*) arising within the Buddhist monastic order.
